title: Chloe's ticket
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Chloe has a ticket. She shows it to the dog, not Wood. The dog sniffs it. Wood sees the date across the seawall: October, a Sunday. Not September. He does the arithmetic and doesn't say the answer. She says she's staying through the derby — no. Through October. She doesn't say why.

panels.composition: The seawall. CHLOE holding a bus ticket down to BARNABY, who sniffs it. WOOD ten feet off with the pad, seeing the date.

image.prompt: a young woman on a seawall holding a bus ticket down for a small dog to sniff while a young man ten feet away reads it from a distance, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The ticket: the line, the date as blocks, and one shape legible: a month. OCT.

image.prompt: close on a bus ticket with printed text as blocks and one abbreviation legible, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letter after: OCT (only). The 29th: not lettered.

panels.composition: Wood, doing the arithmetic. Not saying it.

image.prompt: a young man's face working out a sum and keeping it, black and white, no words

balloons.text: Through October. Don't ask me why.
I was talking to the dog.

image.prompt: a young woman speaking to a small dog on a seawall while a young man listens ten feet away, black and white, no words
